story.title: Iran war drives datacenter construction costs up 20% as supply chains fracture globally
story.summary: The ongoing Iran war is disrupting global datacenter construction supply chains, with the British Computer Society reporting that builders are facing material cost increases of up to 20% alongside patchy delivery schedules for critical components. The disruption threatens to delay AI infrastructure buildout at a time when hyperscalers are racing to commission new compute capacity. The supply chain strain has global implications, affecting projects from the Gulf region to Europe and beyond.
